productArea.name: Status pages
productArea.scope: Create, edit, and delete status pages, configure their slugs, domains, groups, monitor display, refresh and heartbeat settings, and manage public incident posts, resolution, deletion, pinning, and history. Following a monitor link does not include testing its dashboard or configuration.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Status Pages and open a page's /status/<slug> link for its public view, editor, and incident controls.
Choose New Status Page and enter its title and slug before opening the editor.
Open the page whose slug is default, if it exists. Custom status page domains show their assigned page at the root URL.
Open the seeded public status page, then choose Edit Status Page for its editor or incident controls after signing in.
